Remark
[Exclusion of conical degeneration] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0160 ↗ thm:chow-iii-kappa-harnack-compactness 1. ch20:20.13\group Compactness

The compactness theorem rules out curvature blow-up a uniformly bounded distance from basepoints of bounded curvature; in particular, a sequence cannot develop a singular Euclidean-cone pointed limit at such a point.
